decision.reasoning_trace: I specifically focused on actual backpacks in the feed, filtering out the camping accessories, towels, and chairs. My consideration set included a mix of daily-use (adidas mesh), sports-specific (DeMarini baseball), high-end tactical (Maxpedition), hydration-focused (UDIHEDA), and general hiking (SHENHU) options. I ultimately selected the SHENHU 40L Hiking Backpack as the best value; it provides significant storage space and features suitable for outdoor activities (like trekking pole attachments) at a very affordable price point compared to the specialized sports or tactical bags.
